reviews.text: Took me some time. It took me a while to decide to finally decide buy the full version. I appreciate that it’s ad free from the very get go which is rare. I was put off that it felt a bit male oriented but to be fair most Chibi apps are girly so I understand why, it’s just that I am a girl that likes the girly stuff. I finally decided to keep it and get the full version as I discovered the true extent of customization within the app and how you can change the clothing and hair colors which really can change the tone from dreary male to a more girly vibe. So it’s definitely worth adding to my ever growing list of Chibi dress up apps (and just dress up games in general) collection bc surprisingly each one does something different and so they are all worth having. I also want to make sure to support developers that choose one time fees over subscriptions, micro transactions and virtual currencies as those tend to ruin the gaming experience more often than not.
